// <auto-generated/>
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
[assembly: Microsoft.VisualStudio.TestTools.UnitTesting.DoNotParallelize]
namespace CobolCS.Generated.Tests;
/// <summary>レビュー状態と固定ファイルのハッシュをテスト時にも検証します。</summary>
internal static class Review
{
    internal static string Root()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (directory != null && !File.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "CobolCS.Generated.csproj"))) directory = directory.Parent;
        return directory?.FullName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot find generated solution");
    }
    internal static JsonNode Require(string programId, string caseId, CallStubMode mode, bool hasNoOpCalls)
    {
        if (mode != CallStubMode.Throw || hasNoOpCalls) throw new InvalidOperationException("Exploration cannot be a business baseline");
        var root = Root();
        var review = JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, "Tests/review.json")))!;
        if (review["schemaVersion"]!.GetValue<int>() != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unknown review schema");
        var entry = review["cases"]!.AsArray().Single(c => c!["programId"]!.GetValue<string>() == programId && c["caseId"]!.GetValue<string>() == caseId)!;
        if (!entry["reviewed"]!.GetValue<bool>() || entry["hasNoOpCalls"]!.GetValue<bool>() || entry["callStubMode"]!.GetValue<string>() != "Throw") throw new InvalidOperationException("Unreviewed or exploratory baseline");
        foreach (var pair in entry["files"]!.AsObject())
        {
            if (Path.IsPathRooted(pair.Key) || pair.Key.Contains('\\') || pair.Key.Split('/').Any(p => p is ".." or "." or "")) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsafe review path");
            var hash = Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(Path.Combine(root, pair.Key))));
            if (hash != pair.Value!.GetValue<string>()) throw new InvalidOperationException("Review hash mismatch: " + pair.Key);
        }
        return entry;
    }
}
